user_prompt: Compare two hypothetical collateral offers for the disclosed guarantee exposure. Separate principal, restricted liquidity, fees, net opportunity cost and expected loss. Show initial budget feasibility and full-call cash stress; do not treat released collateral as profit or approve banking actions.

roles.evidence_contract: Validate conditional source status, dates, units and bounds; source-content and legal review remain human.
roles.project_finance_analyst: Reconcile cash lock-up and costs for equal liabilities and horizon. Expose adverse full-call liquidity.
roles.energy_orchestrator: Evidence first, isolated finance handoff, registered ready tasks only.

input_schema: case.json v1.0; finite bounded numeric assumptions; two offers baseline/alternative; NIS; horizon 1/12..10 years; probabilities, loss, share, rates and collateral fractions 0..1; nonnegative fees/budget; evidence gaps required
handoffs: Evidence gate to existing finance role
Treasury, legal and bank review before any real commitment
output_contract: Input hash, source status, cash/cost ledger
No banking authority; approval unknown; no LLM measurements
acceptance: Explicit synthetic terms and proposal status
